name: toll
description: Safety checks before an agent buys a coin, signs a transaction or pays an agent: who is behind a coin, a one-word gate before a buy, the dev's record, LP pull risk, LARP check, pre-sign check (ERC-8265), a wallet's live approvals, ERC-8004 agent check, paid x402 API search, Uniswap v4 hook check, and Robinhood Stock Token market data (fundamentals, insiders, 13F holders, guidance, events, macro). 24 read-only lookups; 4 webhook watch tools that need the user's own Toll key.
